label: sidea_wafer_prober_equipment
definition: 矽电股份 晶圆探针台 product line: wafer probe stations from manual to fully automatic, 4-12 inch, +/-1.3 micrometre positioning, Taiko and ultra-thin wafer probing, OHT-compatible, dual-arm auto load/unload, auto card change and auto needle alignment. Probe stations only: no ATE tester and no probe card.

label: sidea_die_prober_equipment
definition: 矽电股份 晶粒探针台 product line: die probe stations for singulated dies after dicing, 4-6 inch PD/APD/LED optoelectronic chips, four-magazine dual-channel auto load/unload, Z-axis probe motion, non-destructive needle cleaning, integrating-sphere range auto-recognition, probe-mark recognition. Combined with an in-house or third-party current source it is sold as a 探针测试一体机.

label: sidea_other_equipment
definition: 矽电股份 其他 product revenue line: a mixed basket of 分选机 (three-station LED chip sorter, up to 300 BIN), 曝光机 (contact aligner for 6/4 inch diode wafers) and AOI 检测机 (sub-micron optical defect inspection for 12/8/4 inch optoelectronic and discrete devices). Not allocable between these tool classes.

label: sidea_equipment_manufacturing_segment
definition: 矽电股份 设备制造业 segment as disclosed in 营业收入构成: the issuer's only industry segment, equal to total operating revenue, and also the basis for the 分地区 (境内/境外) and 分销售模式 (直销/代理) splits.

label: sidea_special_equipment_manufacturing_volumes
definition: 矽电股份 专用设备制造业 row of the 实物销售收入 table carrying 销售量/生产量/库存量 in 台. A single collective total across both prober families and the 其他 basket; the issuer publishes no per-product unit counts, so it cannot be allocated.

label: sidea_company_disclosures
definition: 矽电股份 company-wide annual-report disclosures: revenue and net profit for FY2023-FY2025, R&D expense, cumulative patents and software copyrights, the mandatory 员工情况 workforce table and the mandatory top-five customer and supplier tables.

label: 主营业务合计
definition: Sidea 合计 row of the H1 2026 分产品 table, equal to 主营业务 in the revenue note and below company 营业收入 by 其他业务. Spans both prober families and the 其他设备 basket.

label: 其他业务
definition: Sidea 其他业务 row of the H1 2026 revenue note: the residual between 主营业务 and company 营业收入. Its content is not itemised.

label: 晶圆探针台和晶粒探针台
definition: Sidea wafer and die prober families together, as one count of models. The source gives no split, and the two sit in different atlas categories.
